a.xlink:title: Wake the daisy-chained set of ADBMS6380 devices.
Periodic service routine for connection, measurements, and balancing.
Read all cell voltages from each module via RDCVA..RDCVF.
Read all GPIO/aux voltages from each module via RDAUXA..RDAUXD.
Read back REGA from all modules and compare with cached configuration.
Read back REGB from all modules and compare with cached configuration.
Start an ADAX conversion, read all GPIO voltages, and convert to thermistor temperatures.
Issue the ADAX command to start GPIO/aux voltage conversions across all modules.
Issue the ADCV command to start cell voltage conversions across all modules.
Encode and write REGA configuration to all modules in the daisy chain.
Encode and write REGB configuration (OV/UV thresholds + discharge bits) to all modules.
